name: Tekle Yohannes
title: Your Trusted Partner.
subtitle: About The Agent
paragraphs: As a premier luxury real estate advisor in Ethiopia, I specialize in curating bespoke property portfolios for high-net-worth individuals, investors, and families seeking unparalleled living experiences.

My approach is rooted in discretion, market intelligence, and an unwavering commitment to my clients' success. Whether you are acquiring a waterfront mansion, a penthouse in the sky, or a high-yield commercial asset, I provide end-to-end advisory services tailored to your exact specifications.
With deep connections across Ethiopia and a rigorous understanding of market dynamics, I secure not just properties, but generational assets.
